SELECT SEQ_RECRUITMENT_NO.CURRVAL FROM DUAL
mapper.select:
SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO, RECRUITMENT_TITLE, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_ADDRESS, SALARY_NAME, SALARY_MOUNT, TIME_NAME,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 / 60 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60) || '초 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60) || '분 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24) || '시간 전'
ELSE TO_CHAR(WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS WRITE_DATE,
TO_CHAR(RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE FROM RECRUITMENT r JOIN EMPLOYER e ON (r.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) JOIN SALARY s ON(r.SALARY_NO = s.SALARY_NO) JOIN WORKCOND_TIME wt ON(r.TIME_NO = wt.TIME_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY RECRUITMENT_NO DESC
SELECT * FROM "RECRUITMENT" WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND RECRUITMENT_NO = ${recruitmentNo}
